title: Task step report (C4)
description: Written by a worker or the researcher to <task-root>/reports/<agent>/<step>.json at each checkpoint and when the step is done. The orchestrator reads it instead of the pane; task-decide (research/jev-decisions.md 7.3) takes it as --report. Paths in files_changed are relative to the agent's folder: the worktree for a worker, research/ for the researcher. Check it with task-report.py check before reporting.

step.description: Step id from the task's AGENTS.md plan.

agent.description: The agent's name: worker-<repo> for a worker, or researcher. Also its folder under reports/ and its hooks/ file name.

branch.description: Task branch of a worker. null for the researcher.

head_sha.description: Short or full commit at HEAD when the report is written. null for the researcher.

files_changed.description: Files this step has changed, uncommitted or committed.

turns.description: Optional: the API turns this step used, when the agent can count them. The dispatcher stops the step when it is over the node's budget.turns.

checks.description: Commands run for this step and their exit codes. Empty when none ran.

risks.description: Known risks, one line each. Empty when none.

needs_decision.description: The question the orchestrator or user must answer before the next step, or null.

context_estimate_k.description: Estimated context size in thousands of tokens.

summary.description: One line on what this report covers.

handoff.description: Optional. What the next step of this agent needs from this one. The dispatcher points that step's hook at this report; it does not copy the text.

questions.description: Optional. Questions for the researcher. blocking holds the asking step's successors until the answer is in; scope_change asks Opus to decide instead of the researcher.
